req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-020 requires GET /docs to serve interactive Swagger UI with HTTP 2xx. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal GET /docs returns 200 with HTML content containing Swagger UI markers; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST /docs) returns 405; (3) boundary BVA — response Content-Type header is exactly 'text/html' and body contains key Swagger identifiers to catch mutations that change the route path or response type. Each test uses FastAPI TestClient in-process, asserts exact status codes and content markers to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html
preconditions: FastAPI app is initialised with docs_url='/docs' (default)
expected: Response body contains 'swagger' (case-insensitive) indicating Swagger UI is served
trace: R-TASK-020: system shall serve interactive Swagger UI at GET /docs
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/docs")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content_type = response.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "text/html" in content_type
    body = response.text.lower()
    assert "swagger" in body

test_swagger_ui_get_returns_200_with_html()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_body_contains_openapi_and_title():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/docs")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.text
    assert len(body) > 0
    body_lower = body.lower()
    assert "openapi" in body_lower
    assert "swagger" in body_lower
    assert "task manager api" in body_lower

test_swagger_ui_body_contains_openapi_and_title()

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_content_type_is_exactly_text_html():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get("/docs")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    content_type = response.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert content_type.startswith("text/html")
    assert "application/json" not in content_type
    assert "text/plain" not in content_type

test_swagger_ui_content_type_is_exactly_text_html()

preconditions: Swagger UI is only at /docs, not at /doc or /swagger
trace: R-TASK-020: Swagger UI is specifically at /docs, not other paths
NEG: wrong path must not accidentally serve Swagger UI
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_swagger_ui_not_found_on_wrong_path():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get("/doc")
    assert r1.status_code == 404
    assert r1.status_code != 200
    r2 = client.get("/swagger")
    assert r2.status_code == 404
    assert r2.status_code != 200

test_swagger_ui_not_found_on_wrong_path()
